pages.text: $(d)DNA Helices$() contain genetic information. This can be either in the form of a $(l:geneticsresequenced:genes)Gene/$, or an $(9)Entity$().$(br2)Freshly crafted, a DNA Helix contains only the Entity that the DNA came from.

This DNA Helix contains the genetic information of a $(9)Cow$(), but the actual Gene it has is $(c)unknown$(). To decrypt it, you'll need to pass it through a $(l:geneticsresequenced:blocks/dna_decryptor)DNA Decryptor/$.
pages.title: Encrypted DNA Helix

pages.text: This DNA Helix has been decrypted, and now we can see it contains the $(l:geneticsresequenced:genes/milky)Milky/$ Gene.
pages.title: Decrypted DNA Helix

pages.text: DNA Helices have a chance of being $(9)Basic$(). This means that they $(c)don't contain any Gene$(), but they can still contribute to $(l:geneticsresequenced:items/plasmid)Plasmids/$.
pages.title: Basic Gene
